checks.text: The page displays the heading "Calorie Counter" and, with no entries, shows the text "No meals logged yet".

Filling the field labelled "Meal name" with "Oatmeal", selecting "Breakfast" in the select labelled "Category", entering "300" in the field labelled "Calories", and clicking the button "Add meal" adds a row to the table containing "Oatmeal", "Breakfast", and "300"; the summary panel shows "Total: 300 kcal".
After adding a second meal with "Meal name" "Salad", "Category" "Lunch", and "Calories" "450", the table contains both rows, and the summary panel shows "Total: 750 kcal" and "Mean: 375 kcal".

Clicking the column header "Calories" in the table sorts the rows in descending order, placing "Salad" (450) above "Oatmeal" (300); clicking it again sorts in ascending order, placing "Oatmeal" above "Salad".
Selecting "Breakfast" in the filter select labelled "Filter by category" hides the "Salad" row and shows only the "Oatmeal" row; the summary panel updates to show "Total: 300 kcal".
Clicking the button "Delete Oatmeal" removes that row from the table; the summary panel updates to show "Total: 450 kcal" and "Mean: 450 kcal".
Clicking the button "Export CSV" copies a CSV string to the clipboard containing the header "Name,Category,Calories" and the row "Salad,Lunch,450".
Entering "0" in the field labelled "Calories" and clicking "Add meal" shows the error message "Calories must be greater than 0" and does not add a new row.
Reload keeps the logged meals: after adding "Oatmeal" (Breakfast, 300) and "Salad" (Lunch, 450), reloading the page still shows both rows in the table and the summary "Total: 750 kcal".
